terrain_style: grass-topped olive/brown dirt cliff tiles (Maple Island grassy-soil set) with small embedded grey-green rocks; platforms are earth blocks with tapered/ragged undersides; tile module 90px wide, step module 60px tall; autumn-coloured (orange/yellow) white-trunk trees, round green bushes and grass tufts as decoration (minimap); the mesa and embankment are large solid earth masses with many embedded rocks on their faces (render)
